# The lighthouse: an 8-sided tapered tower (r 0.50 -> 0.36, 2.4 m) in four bands, white (ece8c2)
# and red (c33846), a door, a gallery (5f3a60), an unlit lamp room (f7d554, emissive) and a red
# conical roof. 3.3 m tall, origin at its foot. Flat faces to the front (-Y): every ring turned 22.5.
new
add mesh cone --name Tower --vertices 8 --radius1 0.50 --radius2 0.36 --depth 2.4 --location 0 0 1.2 --rotation 0 0 22.5
apply
material new White --base-color 0.925 0.910 0.761 --no-slot
material new Red --base-color 0.765 0.220 0.275 --no-slot
material new Door --base-color 0.373 0.227 0.376 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.373 0.227 0.376 --no-slot
material new Lamp --base-color 0.969 0.835 0.329 --emission 0.969 0.835 0.329 --no-slot
active Tower
material assign White
mode edit
select all
bisect --plane-co 0 0 0.6
select all
bisect --plane-co 0 0 1.2
select all
bisect --plane-co 0 0 1.8
select face where "abs(normal.z) < 0.9 && ((pos.z > 0.6 && pos.z < 1.2) || pos.z > 1.8)"
material assign Red
select face where "normal.y < -0.9 && pos.z < 0.6"
inset 0.06
material assign Door
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Gallery --vertices 8 --radius 0.5 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 2.45 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Trim
add mesh cylinder --name LampRoom --vertices 8 --radius 0.28 --depth 0.42 --location 0 0 2.71 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Lamp
add mesh cone --name Cap --vertices 8 --radius1 0.42 --radius2 0 --depth 0.38 --location 0 0 3.11 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Red
select all
apply
shade flat
inspect stats
export lighthouse.glb
